label: Kpower
description: This extension for Karoo devices adds a device simulates a virtual power meter.
releaseNotes: Fork of KPower 1.9.6: acceleration term, 0 W clamp, optional auto-calibration of CdA and Crr from coasting. Updates come from github.com/mostafa-k-m/Karoo-KPower. Coming from the original KPower you need to uninstall it first (different signing key).
